title: WAGMI
tagline: WAGMI.ai is an all-in-one NFT analytics tool, for everyone. Tracks new mints, trending projects, and statistics for every Ethereum-based NFT.
description: The NFT space is blowing up, but it's still very fragmented. WAGMI.ai surfaces the most promising NFTs, using a combination of on-chain and off-chain analytics. WAGMI.ai tracks and indexes all opensea transactions and new mints on the blockchain, analyzes them, and displays statistics to users.
how_its_made: We build a highly robust and extensible blockchain indexing solution. We listen to all transactions on the blockchain, parse the relevant data, and store them in a postgres database. Frontend is built in Next.js, and we have an aggresive caching strategy w/ SWR and redis to serve data quickly to users.
